statements: Stated he parked at approximately 1300 hrs, returned at approximately 1340 hrs and found the damage. No note was left on the vehicle.
Stated she did not see the collision. Advised that the store's exterior camera does not cover this row of stalls.
narrative: On 11/06/2026 at 1352 hrs I was dispatched to the Willow Crossing Marketplace parking lot regarding a report of a parked vehicle that had been struck. I arrived at 1415 hrs and met with the reporting party, who stated he had parked his pickup nose-in at approximately 1300 hrs and found it damaged when he returned at approximately 1340 hrs.

I observed fresh damage to the left side of Unit 1. The left rear door had a dent with horizontal scrapes and the left bed side had a scrape extending rearward from the cab. Gray paint transfer was present on both panels. The height and direction of the scrapes are consistent with a vehicle traveling through the drive aisle.
No witnesses were located. A store employee advised that the exterior camera does not cover this row of stalls. No debris identifying the other vehicle was located.
The other driver could not be identified. The reporting party was provided with this report number. Case suspended pending further information.
findings: Unit 2 - unsafe movement in parking lot; left scene without providing information
